A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the linear multidentate ligand H2L selectively formed dinuclear and octanuclear complexes with metal ions, and the dinuclear complexes could reversibly convert to octanuclear ones with the aid of the extra ligands.

the linear multidentate ligand H2L selectively gave di- or octa-nuclear structures depending on pH, which is a rare phenomenon in the field of coordination chemistry.
